{{Current events|year=2017|month=12|day=6|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War]]
**[[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] declares victory over the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] terror group across both banks of the river [[Euphrates]]. [http://tass.com/politics/979442 (TASS)]
**The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] says that [[Russia]]n air strikes kill 21 people in a village on the eastern side of the [[Euphrates]] river in [[Deir al-Zor province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-airstrikes/russian-air-strikes-kill-21-in-eastern-syria-monitor-idUSKBN1E0216 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[New York City|New York]] [[Metropolitan Museum of Art]] is brought to reply to an online petition signed by thousands of people. The museum refuses to stop displaying a [[Balthus]] painting, ''Thérèse rêvant''. [http://www.telegraph.co.uk/art/what-to-see/new-york-art-museum-refuses-remove-voyeurisic-painting-girl/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://tempsreel.nouvelobs.com/societe/20171204.OBS8337/mobilisation-a-new-york-contre-therese-revant-une-toile-de-balthus-jugee-pedophile.html (''Le Nouvel Obs'')]
*[[Finland]] celebrates its 100 years of [[Independence of Finland|independence]]. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/busy_schedule_of_festivities_to_mark_finlands_centennial/9964897 (Yle News)] 
*[[Michelin]] unveils its first [[Michelin Guide]] for [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]], which is the sixth city in Asia and second in Southeast Asia after Singapore. [http://edition.cnn.com/travel/article/michelin-guide-bangkok-2017/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**The "Silence Breakers", including those involved in the [[Me Too (hashtag)|#MeToo movement]], are named ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' magazine's 2017 [[Time Person of the Year]]. [http://time.com/time-person-of-the-year-2017-silence-breakers/ (Time)] [https://apnews.com/841ff18ab80644d78a88a5d7d5101ba7 (AP)]

;Health and environment
*[[UNICEF]] reports that as many as 17 million babies worldwide face potential [[brain development]] issues due to their exposure to [[toxicity]] levels more than six times higher than considered safe in [[Atmosphere of Earth|air]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/health-42250558 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[United States recognition of Jerusalem]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] [[Positions on Jerusalem|recognizes]] [[Jerusalem]] as the capital of Israel and says the U.S. starts the process of moving its embassy from [[Tel Aviv]] to Jerusalem. The [[United States Department of State]] issues an internal travel warning to Israel, Jerusalem and the [[West Bank]] until December 20. The U.S. embassy in [[Amman]] temporarily suspends routine public services and stops embassy travel around [[Jordan]]. Embassies in Berlin and London issue vigilance warnings to U.S. citizens. [http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/06/politics/president-donald-trump-jerusalem/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel-cable/u-s-asks-officials-to-defer-travel-to-israel-west-bank-to-december-20-idUSKBN1E02HU (Reuters)] [http://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-middle-east-42255592 (BBC)]
**Israeli Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] praises the announcement as a "historic landmark." [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42246564 (BBC)]
**[[President of the State of Palestine]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] says the move undermines the U.S. position as a peace mediator while the Palestinian Islamist group [[Hamas]] says that the decision would "open the gates of hell on U.S. interests in the region." [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42250340 (BBC)]
**The [[Arab League]] calls it "a dangerous measure that would have repercussions" and also questions the future role of the U.S. as a "trusted mediator" in peace talks. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42250340 (BBC)]
**Protests against the decision break out in Jordan, [[State of Palestine]], and Turkey. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42259443 (BBC)], [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel/trump-recognizes-jerusalem-as-israels-capital-defying-allies-and-foes-idUSKBN1E01PS (Reuters)]
**The decision draws critical reaction from key U.S. allies that include the EU, France, Germany and the United Kingdom. [http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-jerusalem-israel-capital-declaration-20171206-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')] [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42250340 (BBC)]
**[[Pope Francis]] urges respect for the [[status quo]] for Jerusalem and calls for "[[wisdom]] and [[prudence]]" to avoid further conflict. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pope-francis-urges-status-quo-jerusalem-calls-wisdom-51608418 (ABC News)]
**[[Secretary-General of the United Nations]] [[António Guterres]] criticizes the announcement, saying that it "would jeopardise the prospect of peace for Israelis and Palestinians".[http://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42259443 (BBC)]
**Eight of the 15 current [[United Nations Security Council]] members call to hold an urgent meeting on the U.S. decision. The meeting is expected for December 8. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42259443 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/07/jerusalem-un-security-council-us-recognition-jerusalem-donald-trump-israel-capital (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Suspected sonic attack on the United States Embassy in Havana]]
**Investigators discover brain abnormalities in the victims. They are now carefully not using the term "sonic" to describe the attacks and there is growing skepticism it was caused by a sonic device, with the sound heard by victims being a by-product of the brain damage. The [[white matter]] of the brains showed changes which doctors believe could not be caused by sound. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/doctors-identify-brain-abnormalities-cuba-attack-patients-110255428--politics.html (Yahoo News)]
*[[Sanctions against North Korea]]
**An [[Institute for Science and International Security]] study indicates that (between March 2014 and September 2017) a total of 49 countries violated [[Sanctions against North Korea#United Nations Security Council sanctions|United Nations sanctions against North Korea]] to varying degrees. [http://money.cnn.com/2017/12/06/news/north-korea-sanctions-countries-violation/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in France]]
**A [[France|French]] court does not order the custody of [[Suleyman Kerimov]] but sets a €40 million bail and tighter [[Conditional release|controls]]. Kerimov was arrested on November 21 in a [[money laundering]] and [[tax evasion|tax fraud]] case. [http://tass.com/world/979357 (TASS)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Lebanon]]
**The [[Lebanese people|Lebanese]] cautiously welcome a political agreement that enables [[List of Prime Ministers of Lebanon|Prime Minister]] [[Saad Hariri]] to officially withdraw his unexpected November 4 resignation. [https://www.dailystar.com.lb/Opinion/Editorial/2017/Dec-06/429044-accord-made-in-lebanon.ashx (''The Daily Star'')]
*[[Ukrainian crisis]]
**Police raid the wrong tent of an activist camp in [[Kiev]] and fail to arrest the [[Statelessness|stateless]] [[Movement of New Forces|opposition leader]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]]. A [[National Police of Ukraine|police]] source says police are preparing a special operation and will be unleashed "in the near future". [https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2017/Dec-06/429142-ukraine-police-fail-to-find-saakashvili-in-protest-camp-raid.ashx (''The Daily Star'')] [http://tass.com/world/979307 (TASS)]
*[[Politics of Russia]]
**President [[Vladimir Putin]] announces his participation in the [[Russian presidential election, 2018|2018 presidential election]]. [https://www.westernjournal.com/vladimir-putin-reveals-decision-future-russias-president/ (''The Western Journal'')]

;Science and technology
*The U.S. [[Government Accountability Office]] starts a study into the (currently unregulated) length of [[freight train]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-train-safety/growing-length-of-u-s-freight-trains-in-federal-crosshairs-after-crashes-gao-idUSKBN1E01B9 (Reuters)]
*[[ULAS J1342+0928]]
**A study published in ''[[Nature (magazine)|Nature]]'' and the ''[[Astrophysical Journal Letters]]'' describes the discovery of the most distant [[supermassive black hole]] ever, around 13.1 billion light years away. [https://www.theverge.com/2017/12/6/16738652/quasar-supermassive-black-hole-early-universe-big-bang (''The Verge'')]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 UEFA Champions League]]
**In [[association football|football]], [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] becomes the shared all-time [[List of European Cup and UEFA Champions League top scorers|top scorer]] in the [[UEFA Champions League]] group stage and he is the first person to score in all six group stage matches, by adding to [[Real Madrid C.F.]]'s 3–2 win against [[Borussia Dortmund]]. With a 7–0 victory over [[FC Spartak Moscow]], [[Liverpool F.C.]] is the fifth [[Football in England|English]] club to qualify for the knockout phase; a first too. [http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20171206_03229576 (''De Standaard'')] [http://www.gva.be/cnt/dmf20171206_03229149/champions-league-liverpool-swingt-naar-groepswinst-en-record-ronaldo-pakt-record-en-zege-met-real (''Gazet van Antwerpen'')]
